note: All 11 accelerator deployment scenarios. 'number' is the accelerator's own scenario number for cross-reference. estimatedMonthlyUsd is the published fixed-infrastructure estimate (westus, USD, as of 2026-04-02); NVA scenarios exclude the appliance licence itself. Source: https://azure.github.io/Azure-Landing-Zones/accelerator/starter-terraform/scenarios/

scenarios.name: Management Groups, Policy and Management Resources Only
scenarios.description: Management groups, policy assignments, and management resources (Log Analytics, Automation, Defender). No networking. Near-zero fixed cost. Also the proof-run scenario.

scenarios.name: Single-Region Hub and Spoke Virtual Network with Azure Firewall
scenarios.description: Single-region hub-and-spoke VNet with Azure Firewall, plus management groups, policy, and management resources.

scenarios.name: Single-Region Virtual WAN with Azure Firewall
scenarios.description: Single-region Virtual WAN hub with Azure Firewall, plus management groups, policy, and management resources.

scenarios.name: Single-Region Hub and Spoke Virtual Network with Network Virtual Appliance (NVA)
scenarios.description: Single-region hub-and-spoke VNet using a third-party Network Virtual Appliance instead of Azure Firewall.

scenarios.name: Single-Region Virtual WAN with Network Virtual Appliance (NVA)
scenarios.description: Single-region Virtual WAN using a third-party Network Virtual Appliance instead of Azure Firewall.

scenarios.name: Multi-Region Hub and Spoke Virtual Network with Azure Firewall
scenarios.description: Multi-region hub-and-spoke VNet with Azure Firewall in each region.

scenarios.name: Multi-Region Virtual WAN with Azure Firewall
scenarios.description: Multi-region Virtual WAN with Azure Firewall in each region. Use to match a multi-region brownfield design.

scenarios.name: Multi-Region Hub and Spoke Virtual Network with Network Virtual Appliance (NVA)
scenarios.description: Multi-region hub-and-spoke VNet using a third-party Network Virtual Appliance in each region.

scenarios.name: Multi-Region Virtual WAN with Network Virtual Appliance (NVA)
scenarios.description: Multi-region Virtual WAN using a third-party Network Virtual Appliance in each region.

scenarios.name: SMB Single-Region Hub and Spoke Virtual Network with Azure Firewall
scenarios.description: Cost-optimized single-region hub-and-spoke VNet for smaller estates (Azure Firewall Basic). Identity and Security subscriptions optional.

scenarios.name: SMB Single-Region Virtual WAN with Azure Firewall
scenarios.description: Cost-optimized single-region Virtual WAN for smaller estates (Azure Firewall Basic). Identity and Security subscriptions optional.
